description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City (Management of Condominium Property) Regulation No.03 of 2024.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for condominium property management within the Colombo Port City, including application procedures, documentation requirements, and compliance standards. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
